title: Sister Rosetta Tharpe and hearing Bessie Smith at Dreamland
summary: Talk of gospel in entertainment leads to hearing Bessie Smith at Dreamland on the West Side with Bix and the gang.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: It's very interesting to hear you say that because when Gil was here the other day, Gil Evans, I was taping him, he was looking through my record collection and he saw one that I had of Sister Rosetta Thorpe and another was of Little Richard which he vowed to take home to tape. (LAUGHTER).
And he was saying that she was really the first one to bring that kind of gospel music into the entertainment world.
Well with us Bessie Smith was the first one with us.
Now he was saying that she was the first one to bring gospel into the entertainment world into a nightclub thing.

Oh yes. Bix and I and all the Austin Highschool Gang, Benny Goodman and so forth. We used to go out and hear Bessie Smith at a place called Dreamland out on the West Side of Chicago. And she was something. But Ethel Waters to me, Ethel Waters sang you know.
